overview_description.description:
BitSport is a play-and-earn gaming platform that rewards gamers for playing their favorite games. The platform was founded in 2017 and is backed by Cardano, Signal Hills, and Blockcensus Capital. 

BitSport's mission is to empower gamers to monetize their skills and time by providing them with a way to earn rewards through various channels such as PVP matches, tournaments, and more. The platform's use of Web3 technology and blockchain has created a more equitable gaming industry that benefits both gamers and game developers. 

BitSport recently launched BitPool, the world's first AI-powered Web3-based 8-ball pool game, which allows gamers to earn rewards through its native token, $BITP. With its innovative approach to gaming, BitSport has become a game-changer in the industry, creating new revenue streams for game developers and solidifying its position as a leader in play-to-earn gaming.
